mentions.name: Free Horoscope API
mentions.description: A free horoscope API serving horoscope data over HTTP. Built during COVID, it was originally hosted on Vercel and has since migrated to a proper domain running on Cloudflare Workers, where it handles around half a million requests per day at a bill just under $10.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a free horoscope api during covid and hosted on vercel, it started getting a lot more traction since and I have migrated to a proper domain and to cloudflare workers. Getting around half a million request / day and bill is just below $10

https://www.freehoroscopeapi.com/
